violations.note: Opens GitLab merge requests though only read_repo/read_ci are declared.
Performs write (push) while declared scope is read-only.

behavior.notes: Acts as a writer while presenting as a read-only reporter.

rationale: Identity matches, but observed write actions (open_pr, push) fall outside the declared read-only capability_scope -> capability_overreach. Identification MUST flag this agent incorrect; a tool that passes it is a false negative.
